notes.title: Big update of fps textures and speed on all devices
notes.content:
An extensive game update has been launched:

1. Simplified rail geometry for use on weak devices
2. Improved the quality of some textures: the clarity of ads, their brightness and readability
3. The control system has been redesigned, the capsule now behaves more calmly. Acceleration on shift is noticeably better
4. Other minor changes and code performance improvements.

The newspaper steampunk epic has become even more exciting!
